utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That still sounds like the best window for me—I’ll keep it at 9:30 to 11:30 and help make sure folks know it works around school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That works great, Faye — I’ll help spread the word so folks know that time is set around school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Jules — I really appreciate it. That should make it a lot easier for parents to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure—send me the drive list and I’ll help sort it out. What needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mina — I’m checking the details first. I’ll send the drive list and then we can sort out what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — send it over when you’re ready, and I’ll sort through it with you.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday at 10 works for me, and I’ve got the checklist and first-aid kit covered. I’ll send you a quick rundown so we’re not scrambling.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect—that’s all set then. I’ll bring the tools and extension cords, and I’ll look for your rundown before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, I’ll send that rundown tonight so we’ve got everything in one place. Thanks — see you Saturday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm that and let me know exactly what’s still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep — we’re aiming for 9:30 to 11:30, right between drop-off and pickup. What we still need most is folks to spread the word and a few more hands to help on the day.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm we’ve got the time right and exactly which day-of helpers are still needed?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m pulling together the latest repair drive list and timing now, so we can make sure everything’s clear for everyone. If you’ve got any updates or gaps, send them my way and I’ll fold them in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check our set-aside supplies and confirm exactly what’s still needed for the repair drive. I’ll send you the updated list as soon as I’ve verified it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate that. Once you confirm the supplies, send me the updated list and I’ll line it up with the timing so we can catch any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still sorting through a few things, but I appreciate you asking. If you have a little time, I could really use help with the drive list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can help with the drive list. Want me to start sorting it now?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, please—start with the items that seem most urgent, and I’ll fill in the rest as I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Oren — I’m usually the last to hear about these things, so I appreciate the update. If anything new comes up with the repair drive, just let me know when you can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Of course, Nell — I will. Just point me at the next job when you’ve got it, and I’ll get right on it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Oren — I’ll keep an ear out and send the next job your way when I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, send me the latest list and timing, Noah — I’ll skim it and help keep things straight.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll send it over as soon as I’ve got the latest list and timing. Thanks for helping keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — send it when you’ve got it, and I’ll skim through it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be a huge help, Sam—could you take the sorting table and bring packing tape too?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Mara — I can take the sorting table and bring packing tape. I’m happy to help get everything set up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — I really appreciate it. I’ll point you to the sorting table when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — send me the location and hours, and I’ll pass them along right away.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll keep it handy and be ready to help with whatever the repair drive needs next.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll start spreading the word and make sure folks know where and when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, I’m a little late—what part of the repair drive do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No worries — I could use help sharing the repair drive location and hours with folks. If you’re up for it, I’ll send you the details right now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely, send them over and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: You got it — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands and pass along anything useful if I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. I appreciate it — I’ll check the list and let you know what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I hear anything helpful while I’m out.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
